name: Zechariah
summary: A prophet, the son of Berechiah, who spoke to the people who had come back to Jerusalem. With Haggai he urged them to build the house of God, and the LORD showed him visions in the night.

key_moments.title: The House Finished
key_moments.description: The Jewish elders built and did well as Haggai and Zechariah prophesied. They finished God's house in King Darius's sixth year.

key_moments.title: Turn to Me
key_moments.description: The LORD gave Zechariah a message for the people. The LORD said that if they turned to Him, He would turn to them, and told them not to be like their fathers who would not listen.

key_moments.title: Horses Among the Myrtles
key_moments.description: One night Zechariah saw a man on a red horse standing among myrtle trees, with red, speckled and white horses behind him. They had been sent by the LORD to walk through the earth, and they found it still and at rest.

key_moments.title: True Judgment and Mercy
key_moments.description: The LORD told Zechariah what He wanted from His people. They were to judge truly, show mercy to one another, and not oppress widows, orphans, strangers or the poor.
